result.instructions: Tools for Geoapify, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Geoapify data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run geoapify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run geoapify_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run geoapify_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. geoapify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: geoapify_geocode_search
tools.title: Forward geocoding
tools.description: Forward geocoding — turn a free-form address or place name into coordinates and structured address parts. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/geocode/search.

text.description: The free-form address or place name to geocode (required).

limit.description: Max number of results to return.

bias.description: Bias results toward a location, e.g. 'proximity:13.4,52.5'.

type.description: Restrict to a location type, e.g. 'city', 'street', 'amenity', 'postcode'.

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_geocode_reverse
tools.title: Reverse geocoding
tools.description: Reverse geocoding — turn coordinates into the nearest address / place. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/geocode/reverse.

limit.description: Max number of results to return.

type.description: Restrict to a location type, e.g. 'city', 'street', 'amenity'.

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_geocode_autocomplete
tools.title: Address autocomplete
tools.description: Address autocomplete — suggest completed addresses/places for a partial query, ideal for as-you-type inputs. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/geocode/autocomplete.

text.description: The partial address or place text to complete (required).

limit.description: Max number of results to return.

bias.description: Bias results toward a location, e.g. 'proximity:13.4,52.5'.

type.description: Restrict to a location type, e.g. 'city', 'street', 'amenity', 'postcode'.

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_places
tools.title: Places search
tools.description: Search for places (POIs) by category within an area, optionally filtered by name/conditions. Returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Geoapify REST: GET /v2/places.

bias.description: Bias results toward a location, e.g. 'proximity:13.4,52.5'.

limit.description: Max number of results to return.

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_place_details
tools.title: Place details
tools.description: Get detailed information (and optionally geometry/features) for a place. Provide either `id` (the `place_id` returned by geoapify_places) OR both `lat` and `lon`. Geoapify REST: GET /v2/place-details.

id.description: The Geoapify place id (pass the `place_id` value from geoapify_places).

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_routing
tools.title: Routing
tools.description: Compute a route between waypoints for a travel mode, returning distance, time and legs. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/routing.

mode.description: Travel mode: drive, walk, bicycle, truck, hike, transit, etc. (required).

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_isoline
tools.title: Reachability isoline
tools.description: Compute a reachability isoline (isochrone/isodistance) — the area reachable from a point within a time or distance budget. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/isoline.

mode.description: Travel mode: drive, walk, bicycle, etc. (required).

range.description: Budget for the isoline — seconds if type=time, meters if type=distance (required).

traffic.description: Traffic model for driving, e.g. 'free_flow' or 'approximated'.

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.

tools.name: geoapify_ip_geolocation
tools.title: IP geolocation
tools.description: Look up the approximate location (country, city, coordinates) of an IP address. Geoapify REST: GET /v1/ipinfo.

lang.description: Result language as an ISO 639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr'.
